description: This file contains shell functions for managing U-Boot environment variables and configurations within an OpenWrt project. It includes functions for adding UCI (Unified Configuration Interface) configurations for U-Boot environment storage and scripts for modifying configuration files.

methods.name: _ubootenv_add_uci_config
methods.description: Adds a U-Boot environment configuration to UCI and commits the change.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_uci_config
methods.description: Wrapper function to add U-Boot environment UCI configuration with specific type.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_uci_sys_config
methods.description: Wrapper function to add U-Boot system configuration UCI entry.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_app_config
methods.description: Appends device configuration parameters to a specific configuration file if not already present.
